name: zoominfo
description: ZoomInfo official MCP server for the GTM.AI layer — verified B2B intelligence, buying signals, GTM Context Graph, Conversation Intelligence

requirements: ZoomInfo account with GTM.AI access (and Conversation Intelligence access for call/meeting/email insight)
The MCP endpoint URL and credentials are issued per ZoomInfo account — they are not published in this registry
notes: ZoomInfo operates an official MCP server for its GTM.AI layer: verified B2B intelligence (500M+ contacts, 100M+ companies), buying signals, and the GTM Context Graph.
Chorus is now ZoomInfo Conversation Intelligence (call, meeting and email capture; winning behaviors; deal momentum; churn risk) — a ZoomInfo product, not a separate vendor.
ZoomInfo powers HubSpot's Breeze Prospecting Agent (public beta) as a third-party data provider.
Breeze Intelligence (HubSpot's Clearbit successor) has NO MCP server, so ZoomInfo's MCP is the integration lane for external intelligence.
The 'url' field is null on purpose: the endpoint is not published, so nothing may point at a guessed address.
Chorus is still a live ZoomInfo product (Solutions → Conversation intelligence). It was NOT renamed to Zoom Revenue Accelerator — that is Zoom’s competing meeting product.
Write surface is limited to audiences and GTM context. CRM write-back and bulk export are explicitly excluded from MCP — use the ZoomInfo API.
MCP skills shipped Aug 2026: Call Recap, Call Coaching, Commitment Ledger, AE-to-CS Handoff, Account Relationship Recap, Account Health.

source.note: Official ZoomInfo MCP server for the GTM.AI layer; endpoint issued per account.
